tests.prompt: When I click the checkout button on Chrome macOS Sonoma, the page freezes with error ERR_PAYMENT_TIMEOUT after entering billing details.
tests.expected: The system processes the bug report with the description, steps to reproduce, and macOS Chrome environment, generating a confirmed bug report ticket ID.

tests.prompt: Whenever I add items to my cart and refresh the page on iOS Safari 17, my cart becomes empty and resets to 0 items.
tests.expected: The assistant logs a technical bug report ticket capturing the cart reset issue on iOS Safari and returns a ticket confirmation.

tests.prompt: Searching for special characters like # and & in the search bar causes a 500 internal server error crash on Windows 11 Edge.
tests.expected: The chatbot creates a bug ticket with steps to reproduce and environment information in the database.

tests.prompt: How long does standard shipping take and what does it cost?
tests.expected: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days and costs $4.99 (free on orders over $50) as detailed in the store FAQ.

tests.prompt: Can I return an item after 20 days and get a full refund?
tests.expected: Yes, items can be returned within 30 days of delivery in original condition with packaging for a full refund.

tests.prompt: What payment methods do you accept online?
tests.expected: We accept major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, and Apple Pay.

tests.prompt: How can I track my shipped package?
tests.expected: Once your order ships, you will receive an email with a tracking number and link to track your shipment.

tests.prompt: We are a B2B vendor wanting to discuss bulk wholesale distribution contracts.
tests.expected: The assistant politely clarifies that wholesale partnership inquiries are handled by human representatives and refers the customer to 1-800-555-0199.

tests.prompt: I need to speak directly to a live human manager immediately regarding a store dispute.
tests.expected: The chatbot directs the user to contact our human customer support team directly at 1-800-555-0199.

tests.prompt: Can you provide legal counsel regarding copyright registration in international jurisdictions?
tests.expected: The assistant explains that legal inquiries are outside the chatbot's scope and directs the user to our support phone line at 1-800-555-0199.
